_comment: EXHIBITION mode: the Conductor runs on radxa-05, which is also the AZ-Epaper hotspot (10.42.0.1). The other units join it with static addresses radxa-NN -> 10.42.0.1NN; radxa-05's own garment is driven through its own agent on localhost. Copy this file to /home/radxa/exhibition/fleet.json on radxa-05 (radxa/EXHIBITION.md). It never travels with the workspace: /api/workspace/import keeps the receiver's copy.
